front.title: Automated Certificate Management Environment (ACME) Challenge for Persistent DNS TXT Record Validation

abstract.t: This document specifies "dns-persist-01", an Automated Certificate Management Environment (ACME) challenge that verifies domain or IP address control using a persistent DNS TXT record. The record identifies a certification authority (CA) and binds validation to an ACME account. It can be published before certificate requests and reused without per-request DNS changes, including when different parties perform DNS publication and ACME operation. Use under a certificate policy or trust program remains subject to that policy's requirements.
